risk_factors.title: Enormous Compute Commitments ($518 Billion)
risk_factors.description: We have entered into long-term, non-cancelable infrastructure commitments totaling $518 billion. If inference or training efficiency gains drastically reduce compute requirements, or if revenue fails to scale, these commitments could severely strain liquidity.

risk_factors.title: Public Benefit Fiduciary Duty & Safety Pause Authority
risk_factors.description: As a Delaware PBC, our directors must balance financial return with our public benefit purpose. Furthermore, our Long-Term Benefit Trust holds powers to intervene or pause model deployment if safety thresholds in our Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP) are breached.

risk_factors.title: Single-Source Cloud and Silicon Dependencies
risk_factors.description: We rely predominantly on Amazon AWS and Google Cloud for specialized AI acceleration hardware (Nvidia GPUs, AWS Trainium, Google TPUs). Disruption in chip supply or data center power availability would materially impact training and inference.

risk_factors.title: Copyright and Fair Use Litigation
risk_factors.description: We are defending class-action copyright lawsuits brought by music publishers (Universal Music Group) and authors alleging that training on copyrighted text and lyrics constitutes infringement rather than fair use.

risk_factors.title: Intense Frontier Model Competition
risk_factors.description: We compete against well-capitalized tech giants and labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft) that may subsidize API pricing or integrate competitive models into dominant operating system ecosystems.

quotes.author: Dario Amodei
quotes.text: I think of the coming era not as a crisis to survive, but as a vast frontier of biological and technological renaissance—if we navigate the adolescence of powerful technology with wisdom and care.

quotes.author: Dario Amodei
quotes.text: We did not found Anthropic to build just another enterprise software company. We founded it because we believe the creation of transformative intelligence is the pivot point of human history, demanding an uncompromised commitment to safety and ethics.

quotes.author: Anthropic PBC Charter
quotes.text: The specific public benefit to be promoted by the corporation is to responsibly develop and maintain advanced artificial intelligence for the long-term benefit of humanity.
